title: Finite and tower adjoint compositor data
statement:
For schemes and morphisms in the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] and [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], use constant pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], their intrinsic constructible objects [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. For a finite commutative ring R and a compactification c of f, define finiteAdjointSupport to be the restriction of the compact-support functor [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison, sk-prop-sf-rf-shriek-preservation] to Dctf when the stated preservation proof is supplied, and finiteAdjointSiteSupportIso to be the paste of the site and bounded-below compatibility comparisons [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Define FiniteAdjointCompositorDatum for composable quasi-compact f,g and chosen compactifications of f,g,gf to consist of these preservation proofs, the given three right functors and adjunctions, and a left compositor alpha, normalized on every bounded-below etale witness by the site comparisons and the specified etale compositor [def-pur-chosen-compactification-compositors, lem-sp-finite-compact-site-coherence].

For a finite extension E of Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], the coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], normalized towers [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and specified geometric operations [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], take the coordinates and calculus of [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces]. Define Pair to package the restricted tower support functor, its supplied right adjoint, adjunction and finite evaluation data of [det-sp-tower-gluing]; define left and finiteLeft to be its specified support functors, coefficient to be the canonical finite counit mate [det-sp-reduction-exceptional], and finiteTheta by right-adjoint uniqueness for the finite adjunctions and the finite datum's alpha. Define FiniteIdentities to be the b-composition and c-composition equations, using the actual scalar extension [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor] and direct-image comparison [det-sp-reduction-direct-image], for every m <= n (quotient exponents m+1,n+1). Define PreservesNormalized to assert preservation by both adjoints. Define Reductions to be the two equations identifying actual image-tower reductions with the canonical b and c maps under the specified evaluations; define ReductionSquare to be the natural-transformation square with those reductions for every m <= n. Finally, for separated finite-type k-schemes and separated finite-type f,g over k, define Laws to assert that alpha is the given proper/open calculus compositor, theta satisfies its counit normalization and uniqueness, the composite counit is the composite of counits, both compositors evaluate to the specified finite ones, both adjoints preserve normalized towers, all three adjunctions satisfy Reductions, and alpha and theta satisfy ReductionSquare. These are interfaces for supplied data, not existence assertions.

source.place: (1)--(3), normalized finite adjunction composition, coefficient identities and actual tower evaluation/reduction interfaces
